Subject: EB sponsor bridge & commit timeline

Alex —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. To keep momentum and hit the Q4 close target we discussed, I'm sending a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a proposed executive-brief (EB) meeting cadence that dovetails with procurement steps. High level asks from our side:

- Can you confirm the ACME executive sponsor(s) who will attend the EB meetings (we suggest CFO-level + Head of Data)?
- Are the dates below workable for a one-hour EB readout + 30m follow-up for procurement clarifications?
  - Option A: Tue Dec 7, 10:00–11:00 PT
  - Option B: Tue Dec 14, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Procurement: can we expect any standard contract redlines or SOC2 evidence requests in parallel? If so, loop in procurement email so we can prioritize.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan with milestones), ACME_eval_plan_v1.pdf (evaluation plan & success criteria). I also included a short timeline at the top of the MAP for EB decision windows.

If you confirm sponsor names and a preferred date, we'll finalize the MAP, add attendee roles, and circulate calendar invites and a one-pager for the EB.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0124

Thanks for the heads-up, Marissa. Quick coordination notes from the internal side:

- Confirmed: ACME exec sponsor = Mia Thompson (CFO) + Doug Lin (Head of Platform). Good to have both.
- Logistics: Karthik — can your team own the invite (Zoom + recording + overflow dial-in) and add a private notes channel for the EB stakeholders? We'll want the ability to drop in a short ops readout (10 min) and a condensed cost/throughput summary.
- Compliance: Lauren, please start preparing the SOC2 evidence bundle and the standard export-control addendum; I flagged this as high priority.
- PO row: Marissa, please add a PO/contract target row in the MAP with these milestones: Legal review by Dec 9, PO issued by Dec 20, Target go-live Jan 11.

Suggested final EB agenda (45–60 min):
1) Exec framing (ACME & Redwood) — 5 min
2) Technical/ops deep-dive (Doug + Redwood infra lead) — 15 min
3) Success criteria & evaluation summary — 10 min
4) Procurement & commercial path (procurement + legal owners) — 10 min
5) Q&A / next steps — 10 min

Karthik, can you confirm Zoom capacity and whether we can support shared recording to their SSO? If not, we'll route recording through our secure bucket.
